_comment: Copy to task-classes.json and edit. Class names must match the score keys in your benchmark pack. No model ids belong here: the pick always comes from the pack.

implementation.description: Writing and changing code against a ticket.

code-review.description: Reviewing a diff against a ticket's Scope, Pinned decisions and Not-mine.

evidence-and-measurement.description: Running checks, reading logs and reporting what was measured.

long-form-writing.description: Docs, guides, ticket write-ups and debriefs.

classification.description: Sorting, labelling and routing short items in bulk.

data_policy._comment: A data class marked sensitive may only go to the providers listed for it under allowed_providers. An unlisted or empty entry means REFUSE. An unknown data class is refused too.

general.description: Public code and text with nothing confidential in it.

client-data.description: Anything a client gave you or that identifies a client.
